Simultaneous Linear (3 Unknowns) / Det / Inverse

3×3 linear system and determinant, plus a 112-byte adjoint for the inverse. REG Lin.

keys
MODE→6→2

No FMLA does a 3×3 system. WebCal version II is full Cramer’s rule in REG Lin (no b₁c₂ ≠ b₂c₁ trap). Prompts are row-wise a, b, c, d. First pause is det; then x, y, z. Skip each d with EXE to get only the determinant. Inverse: either solve three times with right-hand sides (1,0,0), (0,1,0), (0,0,1), or type the 112-byte adjoint listing and divide by det. ┘ is a b/c. maxX / maxY / n are S-VAR / S-SUM tokens, not letters.

note

153 bytes (Cramer) or 112 bytes (adjoint) of the shared 680-byte pool. Create the slot in REG Lin (MODE 6 → 1 → slot → 5 → 1). Type ? → : ◢ Goto Lbl If Then from SHIFT 3 (P-CMD).

formula
a1​x+b1​y+c1​z=d1​

Program (one line)

basic
FreqOn:?→A:?→B:?→C:?→D:?→X:?→Y:?→M:A:?→A:AnsY−BX,AnsA−XD;AnsM−XC DT:BM−YC→X:BA−YD→Y:CA−MD→M:?→A:?→B:?→C:?→D:AX+CmaxX−Bn◢(DX−CY+BM)┘Ans◢AX+CmaxX−Bn→X:(CmaxY−AM−Dn)┘X◢(AY+DmaxX−BmaxY)┘X

Adjoint / inverse (112 bytes, REG Lin)

Row-major a11…a33. Pauses are adj entries, last pause is det. Inverse = each adjoint entry ÷ det.

basic
ClrStat:?→A:?→B:?→C:?→D:?→X:?→Y:?→M:A,X DT:?→A:?→X:XΣy−YA◢CA−BX◢BY−CΣy◢YM−DX◢ΣxX−CM◢CD−ΣxY◢DA−ΣyM◢AnsC→C:BM−ΣxA◢YAns→Y:Σxy−BD◢AnsX+C+Y

Example 1: x + y + z = 6, x − y + 2z = 5, x + 3y + z = 10

Question: Use this program to solve the case: x + y + z = 6, x − y + 2z = 5, x + 3y + z = 10.

Given: Cramer listing. Rows (1,1,1,6), (1,−1,2,5), (1,3,1,10).

  1. MODE → 6 → 2 → slot (created in REG Lin, FreqOn)
  2. 1 EXE 1 EXE 1 EXE 6 EXE 1 EXE −1 EXE 2 EXE 5 EXE 1 EXE 3 EXE 1 EXE 10 EXE
  3. det = −2. EXE → x = 1. EXE → y = 2. EXE → z = 3

Example 2: Determinant only

Question: Use this program to solve the case: Determinant only.

Given: |1 2 3 ; 7 8 9 ; 6 5 2| = 12. EXE through each right-hand side.

  1. 1 EXE 2 EXE 3 EXE EXE 7 EXE 8 EXE 9 EXE EXE 6 EXE 5 EXE 2 EXE EXE
  2. Display 12. AC. det is also in X

Example 3 (edge): Inverse via adjoint

Question: Use this program to solve the case: Inverse via adjoint.

Given: [[2,1,3],[7,4,6],[8,9,7]], det = 40. Use the 112-byte listing.

  1. 2 EXE 1 EXE 3 EXE 7 EXE 4 EXE 6 EXE 8 EXE 9 EXE 7 EXE
  2. Adjoint row-major: −26, 20, −6, −1, −10, 9, 31, −10, 1, then det 40
  3. Each inverse entry is adjoint ÷ 40. MODE 1 when finished with REG
note

FreqOn is SHIFT MODE ◀ ◀ 1. n is SHIFT 1 3. maxX is SHIFT 2 2 2. maxY is SHIFT 2 2 → 2. Σx / Σy / Σxy are SHIFT 1 2, SHIFT 1 → 2, SHIFT 1 → 3. Comma between paired DT values. Math ERROR on Cramer means det = 0. Source: WebCal simultaneous8 and Abjont_1.
